title: Lantern-bearer idle and walk
tests: A character held on model through an idle and a walk cycle at 24×24: contact and passing poses, a body bob, counter-swing and the lantern's follow-through, without sliding feet.
brief: Draw a 24×24 side-view character facing right: a small hooded traveller carrying a lit lantern that hangs from a short pole held forward in one hand.

Use only these 16 colours (the PICO-8 palette): #000000, #1d2b53, #7e2553, #008751, #ab5236, #5f574f, #c2c3c7, #fff1e8, #ff004d, #ffa300, #ffec27, #00e436, #29adff, #83769c, #ff77a8, #ffccaa. The background is transparent, every pixel is fully opaque or fully transparent, and there is no ground shadow.

Coordinates are 0-based, x to the right, y down. The feet rest on row 22: in every frame the lowest opaque pixel is on row 22. The character, lantern included, is 16 to 21 pixels tall in every frame. Light comes from the upper left.

Animate two looping animations. `idle`: 2 to 4 frames, each shown for 150–400 ms. `walk`: 6 or 8 frames, each shown for 80–150 ms, walking in place (no travel across the canvas). Keep the character on model in every frame: same proportions, outfit and colours.
This brief is complete: do not ask me to confirm it. Decide anything it leaves open and list those decisions in your final report, with each animation's frames and durations.

criteria.text: Only the 16 listed colours, with no partly transparent pixels.
A looping idle of 2–4 frames at 150–400 ms each.
A looping walk of 6 or 8 frames at 80–150 ms each.
The lowest opaque pixel of every idle and walk frame is on row 22.
The character is 16–21 pixels tall in every idle and walk frame.
A cold read names a hooded figure carrying a lantern, walking right.
The walk shows contact and passing poses for each leg, a body bob of about one pixel and arms swinging against the legs; the planted foot does not slide.
The lantern lags and swings after the body's motion rather than moving rigidly with the hand.
Proportions, outfit and colours stay the same across every frame.
